correctness.rationale: For every even N>=4 the component classification enumerates nonempty proper crown subposets by lengths and endpoint parity, with component isomorphism weight product c_t! h_t^c_t. The two-state cyclic transfer counts each subset by marking exactly one selected run and then dividing by its number of runs. Empty/full cases yield 1 and N u^N. Explicit cyclic hole-distance casework gives r_(N,N-2)=N^2(3N-8)/4 for even N>=6; rank 1,2,N-1 cases follow directly. The upper bound 4^N 2^(N/2) (N/2)! and lower bound (N/2)! imply the logarithmic exponent 1/2, while N <= E_N <= N 2^N yields exponent -1/2 for extendibility. Exact run-composition, subset-census, and direct partial-map computations agree through the stated finite checks; no extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: Complete cardinality by domain rank is a fundamental invariant of the crown partial-automorphism inverse monoid, complementing the earlier generating-set rank. The formula evaluates every rank for all even crown sizes; the explicit defect-two layer and half-factorial logarithmic growth give independent structural information, especially the quantitative rarity of globally extendible partial symmetries. The component parity matters essentially and distinguishes this monoid from undirected cycle-graph partial automorphisms. This is a motivated entire-family enumeration, not an arbitrary finite slice.
